# Retired example fixtures

These four packs are retained only for deterministic compatibility and layout
regression tests. They are excluded from the public Studio, Pages, npm and Skill
runtime packages. They are not an evidence library and must not be cited as
verified research.

- `esl-academic-writing-ai` and `highschool-math-ai-tutor` were explicitly
  synthetic demos. Their realistic-looking citations include invalid DOI values;
  these are preserved as historical fixture inputs, not validated publications.
- `ai-tutor` and `ai-writing-assistant` are legacy-format examples whose source
  extraction has not been revalidated. Real-looking URLs are not validation.

Current public, source-reviewed demos live in `examples/ai-coding-assistant-evidence`
and `examples/workplace-ai-assistant`. Fixture generators target this directory.
Do not publish generated fixture reports or merge their findings into research.
